definitions.gloss: waiting on tables; serving food and drinks
definitions.explanation: The act of serving food and drinks to guests or customers.
A person who serves food and drinks, especially in a formal or traditional setting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給仕|きゅうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary word for table service or a server. Composed of {給|きゅう} (provide) + {仕|じ} (serve).

REGISTER:
In modern casual speech, ⟦ウェイター→ウェイター：05114_weitaa⟧, ⟦ウェイトレス→ウェイトレス：05115_weitoresu⟧, or ⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧ are more common for restaurant servers. {給仕|きゅうじ} carries a traditional or refined nuance and is used more in formal settings, hotels, and ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給仕|きゅうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to serve, to wait on tables
- {給仕|きゅうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|ゆ}き⟦{届|とど}いて→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: the service is attentive
- {給仕|きゅうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: server work
- {給仕|きゅうじ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a server

At ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧, the traditional server is called ⟦{仲居|なかい}→仲居：11719_nakai⟧ rather than {給仕|きゅうじ}.
